content: In ~/GNUstep/scripts/setup-gnustep.sh, anifetch (github.com/Notenlish/anifetch) must be installed via the AUR package named anifetch-cli, NOT "anifetch" which is an unrelated package (github.com/anixne/anifetch). ffmpeg and chafa are in the official extra repo (pacman -S ffmpeg chafa). User requires check-only mode: never actually install packages when testing this script.

WindowMaker on this machine is built from latest git (github.com/window-maker/wmaker, master branch, currently 0.96.0 commit 17d44e15), NOT the pacman package. Build steps verified working: git clone to ~/.cache/wmaker-build -> ./autogen.sh -> ./configure --prefix=/usr --sysconfdir=/etc -> make -j$(nproc) -> sudo make install -> sudo ldconfig. Build deps: base-devel + fontconfig giflib imagemagick libexif libjpeg-turbo libpng libtiff libwebp libx11 libxext libxft libxinerama libxmu libxpm libxrandr pango xorg-xset. Last-built commit tracked in ~/GNUstep/scripts/.wmaker-last-commit. The git 'next' branch is stale (0.95.9, 2023) - master is the current line. Previously installed 0.97.0 was from a different/forked source; the current master build reports 0.96.0.

Equibop (equicord fork of Vesktop) tray icon bug on wmaker/wmsystemtray X11: root cause is in snixembed 0.3.3 (SNI->XEmbed bridge, Arch package 0.3.3-2). Two code bugs in src/proxyicon.vala: (1) set_icon_pixmap takes pixmaps[0] with no scaling -> equibop's single 32x32 ARGB pixmap drawn unscaled into 24x24 tray slot -> too large/clipped; (2) ARGB->RGBA conversion loop uses `i += 3` (in-place rotate of overlapping 4-byte windows) instead of `i += 4` -> scrambled/garbled opaque blob. Bug present in both 0.3.3 and master (6339baf, commit 135406b adds scaling via choose_best_pixmap/scale_pixbuf but keeps i+=3). Equibop side (src/main/tray.ts): static/tray/tray.png 256x256 resized to 32x32, sent as single premultiplied-ARGB pixmap, IconName empty. Fix: patch snixembed (i+=3->i+=4 + port scale logic) and rebuild. wmsystemtray sets no _NET_SYSTEM_TRAY_ICON_SIZE so GTK falls back to 22px.

walgen.py created at ~/GNUstep/scripts/walgen.py (Aug 2026): optimal wallpaper color extraction replacing pywal `wal` backend washed-out output. Algorithm: chroma-boosted (1.7x a*/b*) CIELAB k-means++ (k=8, 224px max, /31 quantization) then hue-anchor assignment (red/green/yellow/blue/magenta/cyan at 0/120/60/240/300/180, MIN_SEP=30deg, adaptive saturation floor clamp(max_sat*1.15, 0.30, 0.60)) then HSL lightness ladder (bg L0.10, dark 1-6 L0.40, fg L0.82, gray 8 L0.36, bright 9-14 L0.72 + sat+0.15). Fallback neutral_16() = hardcoded NEUTRAL_HEX grayscale ramp (numpy-free).

walgen.py robustness: tested on 75 wallpapers + adversarial edges (1x1, solid, grayscale, fully-transparent, P-mode, CMYK, animated GIF, broken images, 8000x8000) with 0 failures. Writes byte-exact pywal cache (~/.cache/wal/colors, colors.sh, colors.json, wal) verified identical to pywal16's own renderer. write_cache wrapped in try/except, SIGPIPE handled, resize-before-convert (fixes 8000x8000 OOM, 527MB peak), kmeans zero-weight guard, np.abs for out-of-gamut NaN warning. wallpaper.sh integration: after `wpg -a && wpg -s` runs `walgen.py "$SELECTED_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1`, overwriting washed-out wpg colors before downstream scripts read them; also fixed double-slash path bug. Applied live on wallhaven-o5q7y7.jpg OK.

BUG FIX (Aug 2026): wmwal.sh/dunstwal.sh/conkywal.sh hardcoded ANSI color4 (always blue) + color5 (always magenta) for WM title bar/menu/icon, dunst frame/foreground, conky accent — so chrome never matched the wallpaper ("everything stays blue"). Fix: walgen.py now also writes ~/.cache/wal/accents (accent + accent_dim) derived from dominant cluster hue via accent_from_cluster() (accent: L0.55 S0.65, accent_dim: L0.35 S0.55; light mode L0.60/0.45). The 3 scripts source accents file with fallback to color4/color5. scheme_from_image now returns (colors, accent, accent_dim). Verified: blossom.jpg(red)→#d74842, wallhaven-o5q7y7(blue)→#4252d7; conky/dunst restarted with nohup to survive shell timeout.

Final QA + repo push (Aug 2026): Big Pickle review found 6 issues in the walgen color chain; fixed all. (1) HIGH walgen.py: accent used clusters[0] (most populous, possibly near-neutral → hue collapses to red) — added _accent_base() picking most populous cluster with s>=0.10; regression test black90_blue10.png now yields blue #4264d7. (2) MEDIUM: stale accents file on neutral fallback — main() now removes ~/.cache/wal/accents when accent is None. (3) MEDIUM wmwal.sh: MenuTextColor color0→color7 (contrast 2.1:1→5.4:1). (4) LOW wallpaper.sh: basename path rebuilt (broken for subdirs/dupes) — now matches full path from find output. (5) LOW fehbg.sh single-quote escaping. (6) LOW lab_to_rgb sign loss (left as-is). Full sweep 74/74 OK, semgrep clean. Pushed commit a6b3c32 to https://github.com/slimulv1/wmaker-dotfiles (main): added scripts/walgen.py, updated conkywal/dunstwal/wallpaper/wmwal scripts, rewrote README.md minimal (packages + install, no AI style). keybinds.sh + check-wmaker-update.sh left as repo xterm version (local kitty is machine-specific).

User preference: all new projects and test assets belong in ~/Projects/ from now on (not /tmp/opencode, not home root). Example: walgen test suite moved to ~/Projects/walgen-tests/. When creating project dirs, test suites, or new work artifacts, place them under ~/Projects/.

User preference: new project directories under ~/Projects/ must use tidy, clear, readable naming (e.g. ~/Projects/walgen-tests/) so the user can easily read and manage them. Consistent naming convention, no cryptic/random names.
